cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 70% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.19% · WTI +2.68% · Brent -1.27% · NatGas -2.58%. 70% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Refining & Downstream is doing the heavy lifting at +5.15%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Power & IPPs lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +5.15%; weakest is Power & IPPs at +0.25%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: MPC is the standout at +6.25%
cards.body: Leaders: MPC +6.25%, VLO +5.26%, DINO +5.01%, OXY +4.57%, TLN +4.10%. Laggards: ARRY -3.47%, SEDG -3.04%, NXE -2.31%, UUUU -2.18%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
